skills.name: Defensive Magic
skills.description: Creates a magic barrier, blocking enemy attacks. Good effects on allies.  *Creates a shield over an area (4 sec) *Allies' Skill Range +20% (7 sec)

skills.name: Zoltraak
skills.description: Modern day basic offensive magic. Bad effects on enemies.  *Cancels enemy invincibility skills  *ATK x 3500% Area Damage  *Stuns enemies (3 sec) *Enemy Skill Hit Rate -45% (7 sec)

abilities.name: Group: Frieren
abilities.description: Frieren Tie-Up! Put Rangers of a group into a Team and ATK buffs will be applied in battle. You must have a Team of at least 2 Rangers for group buffs to apply. The more Rangers you have in a Team from the same group, the stronger the buffs will be. (There are 5 buff levels.)

abilities.name: Skill Barrier
abilities.description: Continuously provides a barrier that protects against Skill Damage. - The Skill Barrier disappears after blocking Skill Damage 1 time and is reapplied 3 seconds later. - The Skill Barrier remains intact when Skill Damage is reduced to 0 through invincibility. - Boss, Guardian, and Special Type enemies' Skill Damage cannot be blocked.
